lines: — DAY 90 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Gray Squirrel (cleaned); Hickory Nuts (in shell) went bad — beyond saving. You leave them for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
💬 Sanne whispers: "Someone's been leaving food out, and Wren won't admit a thing. Don't ask me how I know it wasn't one of us."
"Three losses. The crowd is getting that look. You know the look."
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.
Dawn. You wake rested. (+5 health, energy restored. Your sleeping body burned less — 12 kcal conserved. By the fire. Good enough.)
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (12/10/5), 9 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
The relief moment passes — the crisis runs its own course now. What you did stands; what you didn't, doesn't.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
Nino left 3 wood logs by the stash. No announcement. That's how it works here.
Ruby wanders off. "I want to see what's out there."
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 3L carried (3kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 21L left.
Nino is sweeping the corners out, muttering at the dust.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
◈ ABILITY — Spotlight: The room is already warm. Audience starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — Callback: One bad act can be redone. (Offered once, after a bad beat.)
◈ ABILITY — Plant: A cheering section, planted. +2 now — pray they never check the seating chart.
◈ ABILITY — Edit Bay: Final cut on your own legend. (Offered in the final beat.)
🔴 LIVE! the variety finale: ONE NIGHT ONLY

◈ THE BELOVED — The audience is chanting. You don't know the words — it isn't a language with words — but you know the feeling. The table can't move against the cast's favorite. That's leverage. Tonight, the cast is your village.
The table has read your ledger. The food truth was shared. The dark road is open.
Sigrun tells the hunt — the real one, with the fear left in. The audience goes silent in the good way. Silence, at this scale, is deafening.
The feast song — the one about eating like it matters, because it does. Trillions of beings who never ate anything hear it and feel hungry for the first time. The ratings spike is audible.

You take the cut. The bad moments vanish — the deaths, the hunger, all of it, gone from the record. The audience loves you perfectly. The village watches the perfect version of you and doesn't recognize anyone.
◈ THE BELOVED — the last choice is yours, and it's live.
◈ THE BELOVED — "Let the audience speak."

The audience speaks — on cue, on brand, on message. The show becomes the government, and the government is *you*, focus-grouped. It works. It will always work. Nobody will ever know if the love was real, least of all you. The ratings are perfect forever.
You came to the Table as the Beloved the hard way, and you made sure the hard way went through everyone in front of you.
Sanne still wakes before dawn with a hand on the knife. Haven sleeps fine. It doesn't ask why.
◈ Sanne Bakker walks out of the light alone, which is how she walked in. The village endures. That was always the story.

💛 You hold Mixtape. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, worn smooth by use, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
Butchering yields: 1 hide.
Cleaned 1 carcass — quick, practiced cuts. Honest portions, ~500 kcal each. (Field Dressing — less waste, kept ~52%.) (8 ticks)
📋 Brian — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Sigrun — 🎣 Fish. Sigrun nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Nino — 🎣 Fish. Nino nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
